# Shared repository instructions

Before making changes, read and follow these shared instructions:

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): project map, commands and development workflows.
- [Engineering rules](../docs/agents/rules.md): domain invariants and files
  requiring discussion before changes.
- [Gitflow](../docs/gitflow.md): branch origins, PR targets, checks and releases.

Keep project rules in those shared files so every coding assistant follows the
same instructions. This file is only an entry point for Copilot.
